personality_one_liner: A high-tech, tactical industrial laboratory dashboard built for rapid scanning, real-time data visibility, and machine-level precision.

spacing.rule: Utility tight spacing. Use dividers instead of shadows. Keep padding minimal to maximize data density.

do's: Avoid glassmorphism. Use solid surface steps (surface -> surfaceSecondary -> surfaceTertiary) for operational clarity.
dont's: No blurred backgrounds over dense data screens.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Home operational view showing the latest AI Vision test result, PASS/FAIL status, and the KHT standard reference scale.

states.empty: No recent tests found. Large 'Run New Test' button.

screens.layout: Hero section is a large, stacked component with a massive metric number (e.g., '8.7') using 'Barlow Condensed' at 48pt+ and a bright green/red PASS/FAIL badge. Below it, an edge-to-edge 'KHT Standard Rating Reference Scale' displayed as a horizontal segmented colorbar (Green 10 -> Red 0). Below the scale, display recent parameters in a multi-column, split panel layout with mono-spaced numbers. Use sharp, flat data cards (surfaceSecondary) with 1px borderStrong outlines.

screens.name: New Test / Capture
screens.purpose: Input test metadata and capture/upload tube photo to run AI Vision analysis.

states.loading: Uploading image and executing AI segmentation model...

screens.layout: Camera viewfinder or image upload block occupies the top half. Bottom half is a dense, single-column metadata form (Sample ID, Oil type, Batch, Operator, Test Conditions like 320°C/16h). Sticky primary CTA 'RUN AI VISION ANALYSIS' pinned at the bottom above safe area.

screens.name: AI Analysis Result
screens.purpose: Detailed view of the completed test, showcasing the tube photo overlay, heatmap, and extracted parameters.
screens.layout: Top section features the tube image viewer with an AI segmentation overlay/heatmap. Include a toggle or segmented control for 'Original' vs 'Heatmap'. Below the image, show a structured data table using surfaceTertiary rows with monospaced values for 'Deposit Area %', 'Length mm', 'Coverage %', 'Color L*/a*/b*', and 'Thickness Index'. Include an export/share action in the header.

screens.name: History & Data
screens.purpose: List of past test runs with filtering and status indicators.
screens.layout: Search bar and filter chips pinned at the top. The list consists of dense, low-padding rows with a thumbnail of the tube on the left, Sample ID and Date in the middle, and the numeric rating with Pass/Fail color coding on the right. Divider lines between rows, no card shadows.

screens.name: Chart & Trend
screens.purpose: Data visualization showing rating trends over time.
screens.layout: Large interactive line chart component occupying the top half. Bottom half is a summary list of the plotted points. Support tooltips or modal deep-dives for individual data points on the chart.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 7 Dark-First Utility personality. Do not use blurred backgrounds or glassmorphism, use solid dark surfaces (surface, surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary) to create hierarchy.

Banned Colors: Any shade of blue (other than the base navy #0A1420), purple, indigo, pink, or magenta are strictly banned. Rely on cyan/teal (#00D2D3) for primary accents and amber/orange (#F59E0B) for secondary/warning accents.

Typography: Use Barlow Condensed for large metric numbers (ratings, percentages) and JetBrains Mono for data labels, table content, and parameter readouts. Everything should feel monospaced and highly technical.
Dashboard Component: Build a custom 'KHT Standard Rating Reference Scale'. It should be a segmented horizontal bar representing scores from 10 down to 0, shifting from green to yellow to red.

Data Tables: For the 'AI Analysis Result' screen, represent parameters like 'Deposit Area %', 'Length mm', and 'Coverage %' using compact rows with clear, sharp dividers. No rounded, floating cards inside the list.
Images: For any tube image overlays (Original vs Heatmap), implement a toggle using a segmented control that allows the user to switch between the raw image and the thermal map.
Ensure safe area is respected, and primary CTAs (like 'RUN AI VISION ANALYSIS') are sticky at the bottom.
